column1: # The interpreter's suite on the compiled path: the programs that the gate's step 7 runs, each judged by its own
# verdict (POSITIONS.md, P-103, "The suite's verdict is the check."; explorations/coordinator/tools/suite-compiled/
# run.sh). One line a program: its path under ProjectFortress/, and the library it runs under, "one"
# (FORTRESS_LIBRARY=one) where it passes there, else "prelude", the compiler's own.
# Its first form is the count of 2026-11-24 on 4b0e3abd6a (explorations/compile-ladder/suite-compiled-2026-11-24/,
# REPORT.md and programs.tsv): the programs of ProjectFortress/tests/ with a run() and no need of walk's reflection
# that pass there by their own verdict, the keys of their .test counted: 185 under the prelude and 76 under the one
# library. The 63 that pass under both run under the one library only, and tests/OverloadSingleParamUnbounded.fss
# is left out: it passed only because an earlier compile had left the api Executable's analyzed entry in the
# caches, and a compile from the library's caches alone fails its second assert (ledger row 1130): 197 lines.
